# Say the Elements (元素怎么读)

> A periodic table that talks: the English names of all 118 chemical elements in American and British voices (normal, slow, example sentence), with dictionary IPA, Chinese names and pinyin. https://elements.integ.life

IPA is shown only when two independent dictionaries agree (Oxford Learner's, Longman, Wiktionary, CMUdict); "unverified" marks the rest. Full sourced data: https://elements.integ.life/elements.json
